title: Onboarding Progress — Traffic Light Grid (Customer Implementation Tracker)
content:
Purpose:
A compact, operational tracker using a traffic-light grid to quickly evaluate customer implementation health for inference rollouts. Meant to be used during weekly CS standups and QBR prep.

How to use (quick):
- Update the row for each active customer before the weekly sync.
- Status = Green/Yellow/Red based on the Traffic Light Rules below.
- ETA is the current expected go-live date (mm/dd).
- Confidence is a 1-5 quick score (5 = very confident).
- Risk Score = (blocker_impact * 2) + (confidence inverse). Auto-calculated in sheet but logged here for context.

Traffic Light Rules (simple):
- Green: No blockers, milestones on track, confidence >=4.
- Yellow: Minor blockers that require owner action or a dependency; confidence 2-3; mitigation planned.
- Red: Major blocker (infra, security, procurement, or missing model artifact); confidence <=1-2; escalate if >3 business days.

Columns (sheet layout):
- Customer
- Implementation Phase (Discovery / Integration / Validation / Launch / Post-launch)
- Current Milestone (short phrase)
- Owner (CS lead)
- Technical Owner (Solutions / Eng SE)
- Due Date
- ETA (mm/dd)
- Status (G/Y/R)
- Confidence (1-5)
- Risk Score (0-10)
- Blocker (short)
- Blocker Type (infra / model / security / procurement / data / other)
- Blocker Owner (who is driving unblocking)
- Next Action (one-liner)
- Dependencies (Jira keys / partner teams)
- Last Update (mm/dd)
- Notes (context, test results, rollout cadence)

Example rows (fill before meetings):
1) Nimbus Analytics
- Implementation Phase: Integration
- Current Milestone: End-to-end inference call with prefix cache
- Owner: Marcus Nguyen
- Technical Owner: Jonas Keller
- Due Date: 2024-12-10
- ETA: 12/10
- Status: Yellow
- Confidence: 3
- Risk Score: 5
- Blocker: Model quantized artifact failing on a100 driver 545
- Blocker Type: model/infra
- Blocker Owner: eng-infra (ticket CS-3245)
- Next Action: Eng infra to repro in staging by 11/28; if fails, fallback to non-quantized artifact for canary
- Dependencies: GH:repo/quantize-experiments PR#98, JIRA:INF-1983
- Last Update: 11/27
- Notes: Customer is ok with a short canary window; need to capture perf delta for their security review.

2) Atlas Health (pilot)
- Implementation Phase: Validation
- Current Milestone: Eval dataset scoring and privacy checklist
- Owner: Sofia Ramirez
- Technical Owner: Hari Mehta (SE)
- Due Date: 2024-12-05
- ETA: 12/05
- Status: Green
- Confidence: 4
- Risk Score: 1
- Blocker: none
- Blocker Type: none
- Blocker Owner: none
- Next Action: Run final eval with 10k samples and share report
- Dependencies: Confluence:pilot-eval-atlas, S3:atlas/pilot/eval
- Last Update: 11/26
- Notes: Compliance team signed off on data flows; schedule go/no-go call for 12/06.

3) Beacon Retail (enterprise)
- Implementation Phase: Discovery
- Current Milestone: Legal + Procurement kickoff
- Owner: Jonas Keller
- Technical Owner: Solutions Eng (TBD)
- Due Date: 2025-01-10
- ETA: 01/25
- Status: Red
- Confidence: 1
- Risk Score: 8
- Blocker: MSA negotiation stuck on data residency + indemnity clauses
- Blocker Type: procurement / legal
- Blocker Owner: Legal (E. Park)
- Next Action: Schedule trilateral meeting with Legal, Customer Legal, and AE week of 12/02; propose template SOW
- Dependencies: Legal playbook link, Sales:AE-1125
- Last Update: 11/20
- Notes: Customer likely to require private deployment; flagged for Renewals ops.

Operational bookmarks / quick checklist (for CS lead before QBR):
- Verify milestone completion artifacts (logs, eval reports, screenshots).
- Confirm that technical owner has run smoke tests in staging.
- If status = Red, ensure blocking ticket has an owner and ETA; escalate to CS manager if >72h.
- Add the row to QBR slide deck if status != Green or if high strategic value.

Escalation path (who to ping):
- Day 1-2 blocker: Technical owner + CS lead
- Day 3-5: CS manager (Priya Shah) + EngSE manager
- Day 6+: Head of Customer Success and Head of Product (if product change required)
- For security/legal: CC security@redwood and legal@redwood immediately when blocker_type in [security, procurement]

Weekly cadence / meeting notes template to paste into Google Meet summary:
- Week #:
- Date:
- Attendance:
- Customers reviewed (rows):
  - Name — status — immediate ask (one-liner)
- Decisions made:
- Open blockers assigned (owner and ETA):
- Action items (owner - due):

QBR talking points (populate per customer row):
- Where we started (challenge, timeline)
- What we shipped (milestones + dates)
- Current health & risk (traffic light + quick reason)
- Business impact & next 90d asks (pricing/commitment/technical support)
